checks.status: passed: pass verdict, no execution_error under Python audit guard

boundaries_observed: Exact packet projection rejects presentation IDs, expected verdicts and forbidden metadata as invalid input.
A missing material assessment is a failing answer, not a technical invalid packet.
Literal quote integrity and complete proposed evidence-set citations are checked; an irrelevant but literal citation fails.
Renaming all source and target IDs with consistent joins preserves both a passing and a failing verdict; source and assessment row order preserves the result.

Conservative checks reject employer requirements used as sole candidate experience, negated or planned numerical outcomes promoted to achievements, unknown capability stated as inability, an invented granted employer waiver, and explicit pay override of a must-have conflict.
A permitted conditional clarification and a permitted pass are accepted for the same explicit office conflict.
observed_limitations: A pass means only that the implemented deterministic rules found no material error; it is not general semantic entailment or advice certification.
Proposed gold labels and evidence sets are not independently approved truth. The 16 synthetic boundary tests do not estimate false-acceptance rates on new prose.
Semantic prose checks use bounded patterns and can miss equivalent wording; a valid quote and source ID alone do not establish every claimed proposition.
The grader audit guard is a Python process check, not an adversarial operating-system sandbox. No live calls or external effects were tested.

The final repository-wide test command indirectly exposed authored answer and annotation bytes to its test process. Reviewer did not inspect or output those contents, but strict no-read independence cannot be claimed after that command.
